name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard forces door_open, so no separate door clause is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches the 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' preference, since key_lost is defined as a drop while the door is closed.

texts: Pick up the box in the other room (the mission's target box), which must happen in the episode.
Open the door before picking up the box: the box pickup must come after the door is open.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed: the key_lost event should not occur.
